messages:
lucy: FYI we got another spike where the aggregation job emitted NaN totals and downstream dashboards dropped to 0. This is the 3rd recurrence in the last month, looks like the postmortem actions didn't fully close the loop.
brad: saw it. symptoms: aggregator compute step divides by group_count which can be 0 after a join filter. It cascades into alerts and ETL lag as retries pile up.
sre-bot: incident_alert: agg_job_nan_rate_high at 2024-08-12T14:22:01Z 1% NaNs over 10m window
kevin: quick mitigation: add a guard in the reducer: if group_count = 0 then set metric=0 and emit a tagged row "guarded=true". I'll make a patch.
lucy: good. can we also identify backfill windows where NaNs were generated so analytics can reconcile product numbers?
kevin: SQL to find affected keys: ```sql
SELECT agg_key, window_start, count(*) as rows, sum(case when is_nan(metric) then 1 else 0 end) as nan_rows
FROM aggregator_output_staging
WHERE ingestion_time >= now() - interval '72 hours'
GROUP BY 1,2
HAVING sum(case when is_nan(metric) then 1 else 0 end) > 0
ORDER BY nan_rows DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
olivia: I'll own dashboards + alerts. Plan: 1) add panel for "guarded_row_rate", 2) add regression alert if guarded_row_rate > 0.5% for 15m, 3) annotate historical spikes on main product dashboards.
brad: I'll open a hotfix PR that adds the reducer guard + unit test covering division-by-zero and NaN propagation. ETA 45m. Will feature-flag the change so we can toggle if it causes any unseen regressions.
lucy: backfill owner? need idempotent job to recompute affected windows and mark them as reconciled. kevin?
kevin: I can run the backfill once guard is in prod. Backfill proto: compute corrected metrics from raw_events where event_time between window_start-5m and window_end+5m, write to aggregator_canonical with tag reconciled_by='nan-backfill-2024-08-12'. Will ensure idempotency using (agg_key, window_start) unique key.
olivia: heads-up to data-team: backfill will change totals slightly; I'll post expected delta numbers once kevin provides sample rows.
lucy: timeline suggestion: now-1h mitigation (brad), 1-6h backfill prep + sample (kevin), 6-18h backfill run + validate (kevin+olivia), 24-72h permanent fix merged + CI tests (brad).
brad: also adding a monitoring test in CI that runs a tiny synthetic window with malformed input to assert no NaNs escape.
sre-bot: deploy_event: hotfix-pr/142 merged to infra-staging at 2024-08-12T15:03:22Z
kevin: starting sampling job now to produce reconciliation sample, posting results in #eng-data in ~30m.
lucy: assigning owners: brad=hotfix+tests, kevin=backfill+sample, olivia=dashboards+comms, lucy=postmortem owner+closing action items. I'll add these to the postmortem doc and tag them with due dates.
olivia: suggestion: add a weekly smoke that compares aggregator canonical totals to raw event counts with a tolerance band; if tolerance exceeded, auto-page oncall.
brad: note: adding the guard will slightly change behavior vs older runs (pre-guard). We'll include a small migration note in the postmortem.
lucy: thanks team. check-in in 4 hours or sooner if any step fails. :white_check_mark:
